name: Auburn Farmers Market
tagline: Mosby Farm — Beets in Auburn, WA
description: Auburn Farmers Market gathers local farms and food producers in 1140 Auburn Way South, WA. The market is a hub for seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from nearby growers. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
